message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. Centered in the upper portion is the large red word "TEMPO" in a sans-serif font. Above this, white text reads "GAYA MEWAH BUPATI SULA". To the right, smaller white text states "EDISI 24-30 JUNI 2013".

The central image features the front grill and hood of a dark, metallic car. A chrome hood ornament, shaped like a winged figure, sits atop the grill. Below this, yellow text reads "BUNTUT KASUS SIMULATOR KEMUDI", followed by large, bold white text that says "PELAT NOMOR".

A piece of torn, brown corrugated cardboard is affixed over the lower portion of the car's grill. Hand-drawn in black ink on the cardboard are the characters "K 050 NG" and "06.13" in the lower right. A small circular silver screw or fastener is visible on the cardboard. 

In the bottom right corner, a price of "RP 33.000", a website URL, and a barcode with numbers are visible. A red border runs down the left edge of the entire composition.
